notes: Faster first response and a cleaner Brain panel. (1) Speed: the time-to-first-byte watchdog is now progressive — the first request of a run (and the first after the prompt cache expires) gets room for a real cold start instead of being cut at a flat 25s and re-rolled into another cold start, which was the 'Finding a faster server' retry storm. Re-rolls after it hunt a fast channel quickly (~10s). (2) The Activity panel is now 'Brain' and shows ONLY the model's real reasoning — tool lines, result lines, and status/retry noise no longer bury the one line that matters; empty when there's no reasoning.
